notes.title: New version of iVRy (1.1.7.9) available for iPhone
notes.notes:
New version of iVRy (1.1.7.9) available for iPhone.

- Adds Metal renderer support
- Adds support for latest iOS devices
- Bug fixes and improvements

Requires iVRy driver for SteamVR.

notes.title: BETA: Beta version of iVRy Driver and Android/GearVR/Oculus/Meta/Pico apps
notes.notes:
This beta:
- Improves AMD H26x hardware encoding 
- Improves PSVR2 distortion correction
- Adds AR display support

AMD H26x support requires app version 1.1.7.7 or later, available via Steam DLC.

To access the beta:
Right-click on iVRy in Steam, and select "Properties"
Click on Betas, and select "beta" under "Beta Participation"

notes.title: BETA: Beta version of iVRy Driver is available
notes.notes:
This beta:
- Improves the onboarding experience for PSVR/PSVR2 users. 
- Adds default "chaperone" (room setup) that allows for adjustment of player height in iVRy settings.

notes.title: New version of iVRy (1.1.6) available iPhone/Android/GearVR/Oculus.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34364885/1d5250a7bca26268072321576cba5ebe0e13bd12.png

New version of iVRy (1.1.6) available for iPhone, Android, Samsung GearVR and Oculus Go/Quest.

- Adds support for ARKit/ARCore 6DOF AR/camera tracking
- Adds monoscopic/2D "magic window" support for viewing VR content without headset
- Support for latest devices
- Bug fixes and improvements

Requires iVRy driver version 1.1.6.0 or later.

notes.title: New version of iVRy (1.1.5.1) available for Android.
notes.notes:
New version of iVRy (1.14) available for Android with GoogleVR/Daydream support.

- Full 6DOF tracking & Async Time Warp (ATW) supported
- Daydream motion controllers supported as Vive controllers
- Daydream ATW supported on any Android phone with Daydream certification
- GoogleVR renderer available for any Android phone
- 6DOF tracking requires a headset with tracking (eg. Lenovo Mirage Solo)
- Adds USB tethering via Android USB Debug mode
